license_required.quote: A person may not act as or purport to be an adjuster in this state unless the person holds an adjuster license.

issuing_authority.quote: A person shall apply to the commissioner for an adjuster license in a form approved by the commissioner. The commissioner shall issue the license to persons qualified to be licensed under this section.

moral_character_required.quote: must be trustworthy and of good character and reputation

required.quote: To be licensed as an individual adjuster, the applicant: (a) must be an individual 18 years of age or older; ... (c) except as provided in subsection (4), shall pass an adjuster licensing examination

exams.name: Adjuster licensing examination
exams.notes: Exemption available for nonresident applicants previously licensed in another state who are currently licensed or whose application is received within 90 days of cancellation of prior license in good standing.
exams.quote: except as provided in subsection (4), shall pass an adjuster licensing examination as prescribed by the commissioner and pay the fee pursuant to 33-2-708

interval_years.quote: The licensee shall renew the license by the biennial renewal date and pay the appropriate fee or the license will lapse. The biennial fee is established pursuant to 33-2-708.

available.quote: an individual who applies for a nonresident license under this section in this state and who was previously licensed in another state may not be required to complete any prelicensing education or examination requirements

requirements.value: Nonresident applicants previously licensed in another state are exempt from prelicensing education and examination if currently licensed in that state or if application is received within 90 days of cancellation and the other state certifies the applicant was in good standing.
requirements.quote: The exemption in subsection (4)(a) is available only if the individual is currently licensed in the other state or the individual's application is received within 90 days of the cancellation of the individual's previous license and the other state issues a certification or the state's database records indicate that, at the time of the cancellation, the individual was in good standing in that state.

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A business entity, whether or not organized under the laws of this state, may be licensed under this section if each individual who is to exercise the license powers is separately licensed or is named in the business entity license and is qualified for an individual license under this section.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: A business entity, whether or not organized under the laws of this state, may be licensed under this section if each individual who is to exercise the license powers is separately licensed or is named in the business entity license and is qualified for an individual license under this section.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: must be a resident of Montana or a resident of another state that permits residents of Montana regularly to act as adjusters in the other state

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: shall submit to a licensing background examination that meets the requirements provided in 33-17-220

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: may not acquire any interest in the salvage of property subject to the contract with the insured without written permission from the insured

surety_bond_required.quote: attestation language stating that the public adjuster is fully bonded pursuant to state law

written_contract_required.quote: A person licensed as a public adjuster may not act as a public adjuster unless the person has a written contract with the insured.

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: A public adjuster shall provide the insured with a written disclosure document concerning any direct or indirect financial interest that the public adjuster has with any other party involved in any aspect of the claim or services rendered by the public adjuster.

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: may not solicit or attempt to solicit an insured during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence, as defined in the insured's insurance contract
